title: MDR software-related safety, performance, and documentation requirements

it-requirements-statement.description: Minimum hardware, network and IT-security requirements for instructions for use.

clauses.title: Intended performance and safety
clauses.text: The device is designed for its stated use and intended performance while protecting patients and users, with remaining risk proportionate to the expected patient benefit.

clauses.title: Meaning of risk reduction
clauses.text: Risk reduction under this Annex is carried out as far as practicable without worsening the balance between device benefits and risks.

clauses.title: Ongoing risk process
clauses.text: The manufacturer maintains a documented risk-management process for each device across its lifecycle and updates it using relevant production and post-market information.

clauses.title: Risk-control selection
clauses.text: The manufacturer addresses risks first through safer design, then protective measures, then safety information and, where appropriate, user training, and informs users about residual risks.

clauses.title: Use-error prevention
clauses.text: Design measures address use-error risks through device ergonomics and the intended use environment, taking account of the capabilities and conditions of intended users.

clauses.title: Risks and side effects
clauses.text: Known or foreseeable risks and unwanted side effects are minimized and remain acceptable in relation to the benefits provided by the device under normal use.

clauses.title: Software-environment interaction
clauses.text: The device design reduces risks arising from adverse interactions between its software and the IT environment in which it operates.

clauses.title: Reliable programmable systems
clauses.text: Programmable systems and software devices provide repeatable and reliable performance for their intended use, with suitable measures for risks or performance loss caused by a single fault.

clauses.title: Software lifecycle controls
clauses.text: Software development and production account for lifecycle activities, risk management including information security, and verification and validation, consistent with current practice.

clauses.title: Mobile-platform conditions
clauses.text: When software is intended to operate with mobile computing platforms, its design accounts for platform characteristics and the conditions in which it will be used.

clauses.title: Software operating prerequisites
clauses.text: The manufacturer specifies the minimum hardware, network characteristics, and security measures required to operate the software as intended.

clauses.title: Protection from unauthorized access
clauses.text: Device design includes protection against access that could prevent the device from operating as intended.

clauses.title: IT requirements in user instructions
clauses.text: Instructions for use state the minimum hardware, network, and security conditions needed to run software safely as intended.

clauses.title: Device description and specifications
clauses.text: Technical documentation identifies the device and its intended purpose, users, operating principles, software components, variants, and relevant specifications.

clauses.title: Safety and performance evidence
clauses.text: Technical documentation explains which applicable safety and performance requirements apply, how they are addressed, and the validation, verification, and evidence locations supporting the chosen solutions.

clauses.title: Benefit-risk and risk records
clauses.text: Technical documentation records the benefit-risk analysis and the selected risk controls together with their results.

clauses.title: Test methods and conclusions
clauses.text: Technical documentation includes relevant test and study designs, protocols, analysis methods, summaries, and conclusions supporting device safety and performance.
